checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["abalone","iridescence","multi","asset"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); if (!keys.length) return !!(document.querySelector('canvas')); const kws = ["multi","asset","postprocess","010"]; return keys.some(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); })()

transitions.description: DispersionTest model is loaded and both objects are visible in the scene

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; for (const k of Object.keys(s)) { const v = s[k]; if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length >= 3) return true; if (typeof v === 'number' && v >= 3) return true; } return false; })()

Bloom threshold parameter is adjustable and falls within artistic target range (0.1 to 0.9)

checks.expr: (function(){ const s = window.__3D_STATE__; if (!s) return false; const keys = Object.keys(s); const kws = ["multi","asset","postprocess","010"]; const match = keys.find(k => kws.some(w => k.toLowerCase().includes(w))); if (!match) return keys.length > 0; const v = s[match]; if (typeof v === 'object' && v) return typeof (v.x ?? v.y ?? v[0]) !== 'undefined'; return typeof v === 'number'; })()
